#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int index, length;
string str;

bool isDot() {
    return (index + 2) < (length - 1) && str[index + 1] == 'o' && str[index + 2] == 't';
}

bool isAt() {
    return (index + 1) < length && str[index + 1] == 't';
}

int main() {
    cin >> str;
    length = str.length();

    cout << str[0];

    bool flag = false;

    for (index = 1; index < length;) {
        if (str[index] == 'a' && !flag && isAt()) {
            cout << '@';
            flag = true;
            index += 2;
            continue;
        }

        if (str[index] == 'd' && isDot()) {
            cout << '.';
            index += 3;
            continue;
        }

        cout << str[index];
        index++;
    }

    return 0;
}
